To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we give the first constant-factor algorithm for the store-and-forward routing problem and the first constant-factor algorithms for a class of local vs. global covering problems.

(i) the routing time of a packet network is approximable within a constant factor and (ii) for the general class of local vs. global covering integer programs, the local criterion can be improved by a logarithmic term by losing a constant in the global criterion.
